definitions.explanation: A class unit within a school, referring to the group of students and their homeroom. A somewhat formal term used in educational administration.

examples.japanese: {学級|がっきゅう}{委員|いいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{学級|がっきゅう}⟦{閉鎖|へいさ}→閉鎖：14524_heisa⟧になった。
examples.english: The class was closed due to influenza.

examples.japanese: {学級|がっきゅう}⟦{崩壊|ほうかい}→崩壊：09067_houkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}{問題|もんだい}→社会問題：25686_shakaimondai⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{取|と}り{上|あ}げられている→取り上げる：02375_toriageru⟧。
examples.english: Classroom collapse is being highlighted as a social problem.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal educational term. In everyday conversation, ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧ is more common. {学級|がっきゅう} appears in school administration, news reports about education, and formal school communications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学級|がっきゅう}{委員|いいん}: class representative
- {学級|がっきゅう}⟦{閉鎖|へいさ}→閉鎖：14524_heisa⟧: class closure (due to illness)
- {学級|がっきゅう}⟦{崩壊|ほうかい}→崩壊：09067_houkai⟧: classroom collapse (breakdown of classroom order)
- {学級|がっきゅう}⟦{担任|たんにん}→担任：16408_tannin⟧: homeroom teacher

CULTURAL NOTE:
{学級|がっきゅう}⟦{崩壊|ほうかい}→崩壊：09067_houkai⟧ (classroom collapse) is a widely discussed social issue in Japan, referring to situations where a teacher loses control of the class and normal instruction becomes impossible.
